environment.dateNote: The acceptance record deliberately carries no calendar date; provenance is the commit hash and generatedAt ISO timestamp.

attribution.note: The verifiers ran from a fresh clone of the accepted commit with the pinned dependency store shared for tooling; the toolchain and walkthrough tests ran in the accepted clean worktree. A separate-host rebuild was not executed in this environment and is attributed as such.

requirements.title: Settlement slice deterministic replay (SET-01)
requirements.expected: 5 contracts, 17 transactions, stage sequence and final balances verified
requirements.observed: S15 settlement slice verified: 5 contracts, 17 transactions, stages seed → spot → reserved → allocated → redeemed, canonical block 1214, final investor cash 597950000 base units, 2.125 eFUND

requirements.title: On-chain eligibility and root rotation (SET-02)
requirements.expected: real ultra_honk proofs, rotation and exactly-once recovery verified
requirements.observed: S16 onchain eligibility verified: 7 real proofs (ultra_honk_evm), Solidity verifier accepted them, root rotation blocked 29 transactions' worth of flow, recovery settled the reservation once, canonical block 1130

requirements.title: Sponsored order and negative paths (SET-03)
requirements.expected: zero user charge, sponsor paid every bundle, included revert recorded

The record contains no calendar date in its content; generatedAt is an ISO provenance timestamp.
